title: Agrimol B inhibits colon carcinoma progression by blocking mitochondrial function through the PGC-1alpha/NRF1/TFAM signaling pathway.
authors: Xiang, Dongyang; Yang, Wenjuan; Fang, Zihan; Mao, Jialei; Yan, Qiuying; Li, Liu; Tan, Jiani; Yu, Chengtao; Qian, Jun; Tang, Dongxin; Pan, Xiaoting; Cheng, Haibo; Sun, Dongdong
one_liner_zh: 该文研究Agrimol B通过PGC-1alpha/NRF1/TFAM通路抑制结肠癌，仅用分子对接预测小分子与蛋白结合，无蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND: The activation of peroxisome proliferator-activated receptor-gamma coactivator 1alpha (PGC-1alpha) stimulates the transcription of the downstream target proteins, mitochondrial transcription factor A (TFAM) and nuclear respiratory factor 1 (NRF1), which induces mitochondrial biogenesis and promotes colorectal tumorigenesis. Agrimol B (Agr) is a constituent of Agrimonia pilosa Ledeb. that exerts anticancer effects. Herein, we aimed to investigate the antitumor activity of Agr and its mechanism of action. METHODS: The interaction between Agr and PGC-1alpha was predicted by molecular docking. After the treatment with different concentrations of Agr (0, 144, 288, and 576 nM), the cell viability, migration rate, proliferation rate, and apoptosis rate of human colon cancer HCT116 cells were determined. Mitochondrial activity, cellular reactive oxygen species (ROS), and mitochondrial membrane potential were assessed to measure the regulatory effect of Agr on mitochondrial function. Western blotting (WB) assay was used to examine the expression of PGC-1alpha, NRF1, and TFAM, as well as of the pro-apoptotic proteins, Bax and Caspase-3, and the antiapoptotic protein (Bcl-2). Finally, subcutaneous tumor xenograft model mice were used to evaluate the effect of Agr on colorectal cancer (CRC) in vivo. RESULTS: The molecular docking results revealed a high likelihood of Agr interacting with PGC-1alpha. Agr inhibited the proliferation and migration of HCT116 cells, promoted ROS production and mitochondrial oxidative stress, inhibited mitochondrial activity, and decreased mitochondrial membrane potential. Agr induced cell apoptosis and, in combination with PGC-1alpha, impaired mitochondrial biogenesis and suppressed the expression of NRF1 and TFAM. Agr also suppressed the expression of Bcl-2 and Cleaved-Caspase-3 and increased the expression of Bax and Caspase-3. In addition, the in vivo antitumor effect and mechanism of Agr were confirmed by using a subcutaneous tumor xenograft mouse model. CONCLUSIONS: Our findings demonstrated that Agr regulates the expression of PGC-1alpha, thereby inducing mitochondrial dysfunction and promoting tumor cell apoptosis. This work highlights the potential of Agr as a promising therapeutic candidate in CRC.
abstract_zh: 背景：过氧化物酶体增殖物激活受体γ共激活因子1α（PGC-1alpha）的激活刺激下游靶蛋白——线粒体转录因子A（TFAM）和核呼吸因子1（NRF1）的转录，从而诱导线粒体生物发生并促进结直肠肿瘤形成。Agrimol B（Agr）是龙芽草（Agrimonia pilosa Ledeb.）的一种成分，具有抗癌作用。本研究旨在探讨Agr的抗肿瘤活性及其作用机制。方法：通过分子对接预测Agr与PGC-1alpha之间的相互作用。经不同浓度Agr（0、144、288和576 nM）处理后，测定人结肠癌HCT116细胞的细胞活力、迁移率、增殖率和凋亡率。评估线粒体活性、细胞活性氧（ROS）和线粒体膜电位，以衡量Agr对线粒体功能的调节作用。采用蛋白质印迹法（WB）检测PGC-1alpha、NRF1和TFAM，以及促凋亡蛋白Bax和Caspase-3、抗凋亡蛋白（Bcl-2）的表达。最后，使用皮下肿瘤异种移植模型小鼠评估Agr对结直肠癌（CRC）的体内作用。结果：分子对接结果显示Agr与PGC-1alpha相互作用的可能性较高。Agr抑制HCT116细胞的增殖和迁移，促进ROS产生和线粒体氧化应激，抑制线粒体活性，并降低线粒体膜电位。Agr诱导细胞凋亡，并与PGC-1alpha协同作用，损害线粒体生物发生，抑制NRF1和TFAM的表达。Agr还抑制Bcl-2和Cleaved-Caspase-3的表达，增加Bax和Caspase-3的表达。此外，通过皮下肿瘤异种移植小鼠模型证实了Agr的体内抗肿瘤作用及其机制。结论：我们的研究结果表明，Agr调节PGC-1alpha的表达，从而诱导线粒体功能障碍并促进肿瘤细胞凋亡。这项工作凸显了Agr作为CRC潜在治疗候选药物的前景。
